resultWorld.sufficiencyProvenanceHeadingLt: Kaip ši pakankamumo sritis buvo išskirta?
resultWorld.finalShipGraphicForm: minimalist inline SVG sailboat; solid neutral line grammar; no dashed prototype geometry
resultWorld.finalNeedsMapGraphicForm: smaller single-land map with pronounced asymmetric bays/peninsulas, irregular islets, more sea, restrained atlas terrain, direct annotation, neutral pin, shorter route
resultWorld.dottedRouteOrigin: enters from lower edge of the Channel-B map; no visible origin-circle marker

resultWorld.mapTerrainCues: generic and decorative only: subtle mountains, river, lake, grove, islets; no semantic mapping to need types
resultWorld.mapLocationMarker: neutral ring-and-dot pin; no deficit/red encoding
resultWorld.mapLabelPresentation: need label is direct map annotation with subtle text halo; no white result-chip block
resultWorld.shipBackdrop: subtle distant-land horizon + pale water cues; no semantic encoding
resultWorld.mapCoastGrammar: mixed straight/angled segments plus limited curves; explicit bays, peninsulas and concavities; avoid repeated rounded scallops
